title: Chat timeout_s never reaches HTTP client

answer.patch:
--- a/chat/wrap.py
+++ b/chat/wrap.py
@@ -16,7 +16,6 @@
     max_tokens: int = 1024,
     retry: int = 1,
 ) -> dict[str, Any]:
-    del timeout_s
     last: dict[str, Any] | None = None
     for _ in range(max(1, retry)):
         last = api.post_chat(
@@ -24,6 +23,7 @@
             messages,
             temperature=temperature,
             max_tokens=max_tokens,
+            timeout_s=timeout_s,
         )
         if last.get("content"):
             return last
answer.reason: The `chat_wrapped` function explicitly deleted the `timeout_s` argument on line 19 and failed to pass it to the underlying `api.post_chat` call, causing timeouts to be ignored.
